mixed_selection_grips_2026_10_31.scope: Compatible curve and surface grips remain available when incompatible objects are also selected.

grip_gesture_lifetime_2026_10_31.scope: Grip drags cancel when captured source, selection, view, camera, viewport, CPlane, mode or focus changes; Escape cancels without a transaction.
grip_gesture_lifetime_2026_10_31.limitations: Simulated egui input only; OS focus/GPU and human desktop acceptance remain open.

grip_viewport_plane_2026_10_31.scope: Grip drag uses the clicked view CPlane; simulated four-view line and surface tests include a tilted plane and safe parallel-ray refusal.
grip_viewport_plane_2026_10_31.limitations: Physical desktop/GPU, view changes during drag and full Top11 acceptance remain open.

small_grip_drag_2026_10_31.scope: Egui grip drag uses screen threshold and press-relative plane displacement; small Control/Edit Point drags and no-op return are tested in four directions.
small_grip_drag_2026_10_31.limitations: Other views, rotated CPlanes, surface grips and physical desktop acceptance remain open.

runtime_implementation.scope: control point toggles on selected object
remaining: Grip dragging projects onto the active CPlane through the grip.

Surface edit grips are an OM9 extension: they move one pole by the basis-scaled delta, keeping knots/weights/degree and the periodic/reversed record; the grid is tensor-contracted, capped at 10,000 points and cached by the overlay.
A circle quadrant drag changes radius but keeps the circle frame.
Interactive M03-UI acceptance of the toolbar and point prompts is not performed by the implementer.
